capitalInstruments.name: Program-Related Investment (PRI)
capitalInstruments.description: Below-market loans or investments that count toward a foundation's payout.

capitalInstruments.name: Recoverable Grant
capitalInstruments.description: Grant that may be repaid if milestones are met, recycling capital.

capitalInstruments.name: Blended Finance Facility
capitalInstruments.description: Combines concessionary and market-rate capital to de-risk projects.

capitalInstruments.name: Small Business Loan Fund
capitalInstruments.description: Pooled lending vehicle for under-banked small businesses.

capitalInstruments.name: Catalytic Equity
capitalInstruments.description: Early equity into mission-aligned enterprises and funds.

capitalInstruments.name: Donor-Advised Fund Grant
capitalInstruments.description: Grants recommended by donors from pooled charitable accounts.

capitalInstruments.name: Tax-Increment Financing
capitalInstruments.description: Public financing that funds development against future tax revenue.

capitalInstruments.name: Loan Participation
capitalInstruments.description: Multiple lenders share a single loan to spread risk.

capitalInstruments.name: Technical Assistance Grant
capitalInstruments.description: Funds advisory support that makes organizations investment-ready.

capitalInstruments.name: Loan Guarantee
capitalInstruments.description: A guarantee that unlocks third-party lending at better terms.
